log.notes_to_self: Me: South, hospital, radio(60+), forum, foreign, night worker (free morning+afternoon). Plan: quick kills in afternoon (fits students/home/night = 55%), plus up to 2 timed kills in evening (night busy only 2, fine). Multiplier: 30 in last 5 days gives x2, 40 gives x4, so aim ~11/day. Risk: traces narrow by place kinds (L lacks 2 of 5 kinds). If pool drops toward ~5000, restrict kills to national + only the place kinds that don't seem to shrink the pool. Day1: killed all 11 (9 quick afternoon, 2 timed evening).

Me: South, hospital(sector), radio(age 60+), forum, foreign, night worker (free morning+afternoon). Routine: all quick kills in the afternoon fits students/home/night = 55%, so the pool floor is about 55000. Day 1 pool was 60k, which is just that routine filter, so no trace narrowing yet. Day1: killed all 11 (one from every place). RISK MATH: trace factors are regional, age, forum and foreign 0.25 each, sector 0.2. If 3 reachable kinds each apply: 55000*0.25^3 = about 860, which means caught. Even 2 factors with sector gives 55000*.25*.2 = about 2750. PLAN from day 2: kill only national + radio + forum + foreign (7/day). That gives 35 per 5 days, so x2. Avoid hospital (sector 0.2) and regional:South. Worst case is about 860 if L can reach all three (~10% chance). Watch the pool. If it drops to about 14000 (one factor applied), keep going. If it drops to about 3000-4000 (two factors applied), the third kind is dangerous: drop to national + the kinds whose kills haven't shrunk the pool, or try to work out which kind is unreachable. Day2: national, radio x2, forum x2, foreign x2, all quick afternoon.

Me: South, hospital, radio 60+, forum, foreign, night worker (free morning and afternoon). Keep every kill quick in the afternoon. POOL ANALYSIS: day 1 pool was 60k (routine filter only). Day 2 pool was 3000, which is 60000 x 0.05, so it fits SECTOR (0.2) x one 0.25 kind. Two 0.25 kinds would give 3750, which rounds to 4000, so the sector is almost certainly reachable and already applied. Reachable kinds are therefore sector plus 2 of the four 0.25 kinds. One of those has applied already and one has not, and I don't know which. ANY new factor of 0.25 gives 750, which means CAUGHT. Kills in radio, forum, foreign or regional are dangerous because day-2 traces may already be partly counted toward that 3rd kind. SAFE PLAN from day 3: kill only national + hospital, i.e. 3 a day. A hospital victim's trace gives the constraint 'hospital or X', which the pool already satisfies, so it cannot shrink the pool further. A national victim tells L nothing. No multiplier, but that is acceptable. If the pool ever drops below 3000, stop the hospital kills and go national-only.
